# Kaliyugham project notes

- This is Kaliyugham (കളിയുഗം), a Vite + TypeScript browser game using Three.js.
- Preserve Realistic/Balanced graphics modes, procedural leaf/branch trees, ridges, pleated clothing, PBR surface maps, outdoor reflections, and contact shadows. Keep graphics quality responsive and avoid altering collision footprints when improving models.
- Keep world generation procedural and avoid dependencies on external art assets.
- Preserve the early-1970s Kerala setting: muddy lanes, thatched mud homes, coconut palms, paddy fields, rivers with fishing canoes, dhoti and sari clothing, horse carts with drivers, backyard hens, grazing livestock, and forest wildlife.
- Preserve the day-night and weather cycle, villagers' destination-based routines, kalari practice, and coconut harvesting.
- Preserve seed-generated scattered homes with resident doorsteps and clear approach paths, and dry okra/brinjal/gourd plots near paddies with gardeners' home commutes. Reserve their footprints before placing vegetation and rocks.
- Preserve landlord inspections, household cart/manchal travel, sword-and-buckler drills, worker home commutes, far-bank wildlife, ox ploughing, coconut sack deliveries, and Q summon/mount/dismount controls.
- Preserve the household's afternoon estate return and overnight curfew, and tiger/wolf nocturnal trails with dawn den returns. Keep predators on dry far-bank ground, outside homes and paddies.
- Preserve E-key market food purchases, wallet/stock/consumption rules, fishers' market deliveries, nighttime portable lamps and coconut-leaf torches, and procedural material detail. Keep portable point lights bounded and respect pause/reduced motion.
- Preserve the kalari equipment merchant, F selection/R use controls, non-injurious animal retreat responses, forest rabbits, and Malayalam ചായക്കട tea/snack purchases with shopkeeper home commutes.
- Keep the twelve-minute day, evening wage queue with once-daily payments and direct slot advances, and toddy-shop hours, purchase guards, temporary impairment and non-graphic nausea. Respect pause/reduced motion and prohibit riding while impaired.
- Keep physical boards in Malayalam, the market district free of houses, collision/obstacle avoidance and neighbour conversations, and temple flower-offering visits. Historical unequal temple access is depicted, not endorsed.
- Preserve pedestrian yielding to approaching carts, off-road gathering spots, palm-leaf rain umbrellas, farm produce loading/market unloading, and safely scattered banana plants.
- Keep yielding/greetings bounded so crowds resume their routes. Rain umbrellas are household-only; ordinary people use chembu/elephant-ear leaves or no cover. Keep turn-taking conversations off roads and avoid rain covers indoors.
- Preserve hand-attached rain leaves, uncovered cart occupants, road-facing shops, L-key board translations, children home/play/festival routines, and scheduled utsavam decorations/elephants/chenda. Children are not weapon targets or toddy patrons; festival audio is opt-in and pauses with the game.
- Preserve keyboard, pointer-drag, responsive HUD, and reduced-motion behavior when changing the game.
- Run `npm test` for world-system regressions and `npm run build` to type-check and create the production bundle.
